headline: Sensex surges 898 points, Nifty reclaims 25,800 led by banking stocks and foreign inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking stocks led a strong rally, propelling Nifty Bank to a new record high.
Foreign inflows provided strong support to Indian equity markets.
Recovery in IT stocks helped markets overcome the initial weak sentiment.
Markets defied global market routs and selloffs in AI stocks to rebound sharply.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 898 points while Nifty reclaimed the 25,800 mark.
Markets opened lower initially following global selloffs in AI stocks.
SEBI floated a consultation paper reviewing additional disclosure norms for FPIs.
US FDA issued a VAI classification to Natco Pharma's Vizag facility.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp intraday rally after an initial lower opening.
Sensex jumped 898 points while Nifty 50 reclaimed 25,800, supported by banking and IT stocks.
Nifty Bank scaled a new record high as strong foreign inflows helped markets defy global selloffs.
